entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [API Proposal]: The Configuration Binding Generator should be able to understand different common formats of boolean values #117589
  • [RISC-V] superpmi-replay build failing due to signed/unsigned mismatch in emitriscv64 #117586
  • Assertion failed 'block->bbTryIndex == blockTryIndex[block->bbNum]' in 'System.Collections.Immutable.Tests.ImmutableArrayTest #117581
  • [Linux/MACOS] Stucks on Socket.ReceiveFromAsync #117579
  • JIT: Rarely run exception block is not placed at the end, regression #117577

Closed

  • System.Boolean is not Defined or Imported System.private.CoreLib.dll #117575
  • W3CPropagator rejects versions in which either digit is f #117500
    Future
  • `foreach` over a `List<T>` can be lowered like an Array #117582
  • Consider using `$NOCANCEL` versions of `open` and `close` on OSX-like platforms #117299
  • ILC Compile errors during publishing #105947
  • WASM - Dev certificate error on Windows #116695
    10.0.0
  • Cannot Send to a broadcastable socket on iOS 17 device #106588
    10.0.0
